As of March 31, 2026, according to the status of affiliated companies, Hamagin TT Securities Co., Ltd. conducts securities business (voting rights held: 60%), Hamagin Finance Co., Ltd. conducts leasing, Yokohama Capital Co., Ltd. conducts venture capital business, The Hamagin Research Institute, Ltd. conducts information services and research, and Yokohama Credit Guarantee Co., Ltd. conducts guarantee business.
